source: Orion Connect position snapshots (silver api_dims positions_mv, daily account value) and Orion transactions (silver, full-history snapshot 2026-10-08), custodian Fidelity, read through the registry's routed legacy bucket alias
comparison_source: Orion Connect account performance (silver api_dims performance, snapshot 2026-10-08): account-level TWR, TWR, Before-Tax, Net of Fees, Annualized, window Rolling 3-Year
grain: account-windows (one reported return per account over the source's own window)
comparison: our total_return_daily compounded over the source's window, annualised by trading days / 252, against twr_value, absolute gap in percentage points of the annual rate

class_definitions.LINK_BROKEN_NO_BASE: The geometric link breaks inside the window: at least one trading day has no return because the prior-day value is absent or not positive (a closed, emptied or not yet funded account), so nothing compounds across it.
class_definitions.FEE_BASIS_GROSS_VS_NET: Our figure is GROSS of advisory fees (contract) and the comparison source is NET of fees. The gross figure misses, and the same inputs with the fee left inside the return land within tolerance of the reported figure.
class_definitions.NET_RESIDUAL_LARGE_FLOW: The gross figure and the net-of-fee recomputation both miss, and the window holds a single day whose flow is at least 10 percent of the prior value (timing of a large flow against the vendor's valuation).
class_definitions.NET_RESIDUAL_NO_LARGE_FLOW: Both miss and no day carries a large flow: the gap is not explained by fee basis or by a large flow; its size on the net basis is the evidence.

derived_fifo_lots_in_sample.origin: derived FIFO from transactions by the firm's own gold script, not Eclipse tax lots

net_basis.meaning: the same inputs with the advisory fee left inside the return (NET), compared with the net-of-fee reported figure
